content.expected_result: Evidence enrichment leaves current definition bytes and stable identity unchanged; an actual definition edit stales the old evidence.
preconditions: A planned case has stable step IDs. Save its identity, current.json bytes and current content digest before adding evidence.

steps.action: Add implementation evidence, edit the expected outcome in the current definition, then append evidence explicitly superseding the old record.
steps.expected_result: Evidence addition leaves definition bytes unchanged. The content edit replaces current.json and stales old evidence; supersession restores current linkage while retaining both factual evidence records and one current definition.

content.title: Enrich a case without rewriting its definition
